                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m316_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m316_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 316 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m316_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 316 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m316_object_resolved value = 1 }

                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 7 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.817 days = 7 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 7 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.817 days = 7 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m317_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 317 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 317 } }
    }
}

# 317 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m317_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 3
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_stage value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_authorized_viewers value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_access_log_rows value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_leaked_to_source value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_rating_changed_without_evidence value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_authorized_viewers value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_leaked_to_source value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_rating_changed_without_evidence value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m317_anti_retaliation_audit }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 317 market.project_stage_acl"
    }
}

# 317 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m317_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m317_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m317_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 317 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 317 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_acl_review_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m317_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m317_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m317_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 317 application_acl obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m317_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m317_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}
